statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-9546: setting CURLOPT_REFERER to NULL did not clear libcurl's stored referrer, so a previously set Referer: header could still be sent in later requests, possibly to other servers (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-9546.html). It affects libcurl from 8.18.0 to 8.20.0 (not the curl tool) and was fixed in curl 8.21.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/862e8a74a84478d82973471b4f49dc2746c1780e, which frees the stored referrer in Curl_pretransfer() when none is set. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. The flaw came in with https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/2cb868242dc2ac9cd52ee64987ef51d5964a56f9, first released in curl 8.18.0, so 8.17.0-r1 is not affected and the range starts at 8.18.0-r0. In Curl_pretransfer() in the static libcurl.a shipped in curl-static, on x86_64 and aarch64, the builds from 8.21.0-r0 on make two calls to Curl_bufref_free(), against one in the 8.20.0 builds, which matches the call the fix adds. 8.21.0-r0 is the first build of curl 8.21.0 and the first fixed build.
